headline: EPS climbs sharply on both comparisons
summary_short: Noritake reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥71.09, up 63.6% y/y from ¥43.45.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥71.09 rose 63.6% year-over-year from ¥43.45, and was up 20.5% sequentially from ¥58.995 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
